title: BBLINC
description: Fun and Immersive Modpack with some essentials for Fabric 1.21.4!
body:
Fun modpack I made to play with your friends
Some Mods Of Included:

Vivecraft: Vr support

Simple Voice Chat: Fun and silly proximity chat for playing with friends

Aerial Hell: A new Aether-like dimension that introduces new mobs, weapons, and structures

Biomes o' Plenty: A mod that adds many unique biomes to explore

Dungeons and Taverns: This mod overhauls most of minecraft default structures, and includes 14 new Enchantments

Many More Ores and Crafts: A mod that adds many new ores, crafts, and blocks

Nullscape: This mod overhauls the outer end islands, introducing new generation, biomes, and areas to explore

Serene Seasons: This mod adds seasons to minecraft, along with many new features

Tough as Nails: A mod that adds a temperature system and some new armors

Xaero's Minimap and Worldmap: These two mods add an easier way to explore your world, as well as the ability to mark places in your world
